correctness.rationale: For each odd prime p and each exact 3-element support in D_{2p}, the regular-representation Fourier fibers are 2x2 with opposite frequencies (not conjugates for complex taps). For a pure coset, prime-DFT Chebotarev full-spark minors bound a nonzero 3-term polynomial to at most two distinct roots; 0,1,2 roots are constructed with nonzero coefficients, yielding nullities 0,2,4. For a mixed coset, translation and automorphism reduce to taps e,r,s; its determinant a^2+b^2-c^2+ab(z+z^{-1}) has either j=0 singular (nullity1) or one j,+/- pair singular (nullity2), but not both, since ab,c nonzero. Explicit weights realize nullity0,1,2. Thus the claimed rank-weighted values 2p,2p-1,2p-2,2p-4 and exclusion of 2p-3 follow. Inspected exact RESULT.md blob f8f6a6ba0be6007898d51ffb7a862aec5bc17613 and full check_dihedral.py; script p=3,5,7,11 SVD corroborates only, not the infinite assertion.
